title: Evidence of humans in the Americas 130,000 years ago
summary: Graham Hancock tells of Evidence of humans in the Americas 130,000 years ago, about c. 130,000 years ago at the Americas, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: even much older evidence for humans in the Americas going back as much as 130,000 years into the past, 10 times older than the supposed first habitation of the Americas

plain: Graham Hancock, a writer who argues that human history is much older than taught, says on Jesse Michels' podcast that there is evidence of people living in the Americas as long as 130,000 years ago. He points out that this would be about ten times older than the usual date given for when people first arrived there, which would upend the accepted story of how the continents were settled.
